validation_domain: 73 original private-memory ARM target executions;71 real-provider source differential cases, exact GPIO construction/set/destruction traces; firmware modes including signed extremes and unchanged/outdated versions, first/second open failures, ignored callee failure, real FPGA0/2000/2003 results, restart mounted/compatibility outcomes, listener order/float bits, serial sync/close counts, FPGA state clearing; six fail-before-device source preconditions and concurrent nested/restored OutputPin gateway checks;18737 historical programmer protocol/alias/serial fixture regressions.
limitations: All ordinary original return declarations, native fields/layout, ARM ABI and binary interoperability remain unresolved. int32 update/erase and void reset spellings are intentional provisional source-port declarations; matching mangling is not ABI proof.

Root explicitly narrowed HAL scope: implement actual PanelRegistrar resetBoard/resetCS and owned real CCL lock without inventing missing IAudioHAL slots/inheritance. Registrar-to-HAL production binding and original receiver/vptr provenance remain unresolved dependencies. Card uses its existing checked typed live IAudioHAL binding; combined Card-to-registrar hardware closure is not claimed.

Original target ARM bodies execute only in private Unicorn memory. Programmer, updater, start, bundle getter, HAL/listener, GPIO lifecycle and Core lock/debug/sleep boundaries are explicit captured traps; these are not original callee executions or provider equivalence. Source replay executes real canonical programmer, FPGA updater, Card start, ResourceLibrary, GPIO and CCL providers with captured syscall/time/SPI boundaries.

Firmware differential compares numeric results, word44, exact reset/sleep traces expanded by actual start reset and actual FPGA success/error cadence, restart listener order/float bits, serial sync/close counts and zeroed FPGA state at first transport. It does not compare full native object memory, exact internal callee diagnostics, every listener callback fraction or all opaque addresses. Native memory writes and call traces are retained separately.

Native73 cases include arbitrary FPGA callee errors -1 and127; actual provider cannot produce those on the scripted real protocol, so71 host cases compare actual0/2000/2003 domains. These two native boundary observations remain preserved and are not counted as host differential passes.

Ignored native unprotect/erase/programmer-update return traps use -99; source byte-level NACKs produce actual0/2000 and prove those results are ignored by coordinator. Exact callee return equivalence is not claimed.

Successful source start provider has scripted mounted/compatibility virtual results and injected response/time/transport; source status/reset/packet logic actually executes. Its internal effects are outside original coordinator body equivalence. Real FPGA uses generated four-byte gzip image and actual zlib; broad image/protocol coverage belongs to existing FPGA provider evidence.

All source GPIO/serial/SPI/time boundaries installed before construction; accidental fopen/ioctl/socket paths abort. No device, network, host syscall passthrough from guest, hardware flashing or hardware verification. Existing programmer alias regression separately uses a real POSIX pipe and CCL clock, not a device.

Six explicit source-only precondition checks reject null/mismatched HAL, null/missing resource bundles, negative image size and null nonempty image before reset/open. These are intentional source-port domain adaptations, not executions of unsafe native inputs.

Exception injection/allocation failure, actual HAL dispatch, hardware timing/electrical behavior, arbitrary image sizes and concurrency of firmware transactions are excluded. OutputPin gateway concurrency/nested restoration/retained-object IO are independently tested; source access remains caller-serialized.

Current DICE manager firmware interface/implementation already use signed32 and do not override IDeviceDFU, so no artificial DICE changes were made.11 existing TCard test/replay overrides migrated to signed32; five obsolete abstract-class assertions updated because original update body is now present.

Root retains canonical fresh Linux/full CTest, source grouping, installed-role/compile-once, active-source, guarded SQLite admission, tracker/mirror gates. Local archive linkage is hash-bound to the copied baseline archives; it is not a replacement for Root rebuilding all affected consumers.
